[EN] Dakuryon's lab notes:

"Lab Report ADE-0618

Simply amazing. There is a creature living in the sewer, despite feeding solely upon all the failed experimentation potions and the corpses of the failed experiments that I threw down there. It is a crab that serves as Yuanti's mount. I wonder how it got in the sewers. I did have one Yuanti which I had captured for my experiments...maybe the crab was his mount? At any rate, this is a fantastic opportunity to test my process on something that has already demonstrated its ability to survive the rigors of my alchemical experiments.

"Lab Report ADE-0620

This crab is extremely resistant to toxins. It has so far not only survived every step of the process, but it seems to be thriving. I have noted a sharp increase in its size (as well as its appetite). I took a chance and implanted a more complex brain in the crab, and that gamble has paid off. The crab is now able to obey simple commands. It even speaks the language of the brain's donor. The next step is to subject it to chrysalis in the 'egg' I constructed..."
[ES] Notas de laboratorio de Dakuryon:

"Informe de laboratorio ADE-0618

Simplemente increíble. Hay una criatura viviendo en las cloacas, a pesar de alimentarse únicamente de todas las pociones de experimentos fallidos y de los cadáveres de los experimentos fallidos que arrojé allí. Es un cangrejo que sirve de montura a Yuanti. Me pregunto cómo entró en las cloacas. Capturé a un Yuanti para mis experimentos... ¿tal vez el cangrejo era su montura? En cualquier caso, esta es una oportunidad fantástica para probar mi proceso en algo que ya ha demostrado su capacidad para sobrevivir a los rigores de mis experimentos alquímicos.

"Informe de laboratorio ADE-0620

Este cangrejo es extremadamente resistente a las toxinas. Hasta ahora no solo ha sobrevivido a cada paso del proceso, sino que parece estar prosperando. He notado un fuerte aumento en su tamaño (así como en su apetito). Me arriesgué e implanté un cerebro más complejo en el cangrejo, y esa apuesta ha dado sus frutos. El cangrejo ahora es capaz de obedecer órdenes simples. Incluso habla el idioma del donante del cerebro. El siguiente paso es someterlo a crisálida en el 'huevo' que construí..."
